response.sql: SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS record_fraction FROM scanfeatures f INNER JOIN sites s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
